Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model

package com.oracle.database.selectai.model
Typed configuration, request, and value models used by the Select AI Java API.

The models provide builders, typed values, and JSON or attribute mappings for database-backed Select AI operations. Provider-specific validation and database-version-specific behavior may still be applied by DBMS_CLOUD_AI.
